messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P-89233 fired for service=prod-inference-router route=prod-router-latency. Metric: 95th=2540ms (threshold=2000ms). Trigger: synthetic canary in us-west-2-a.

alex: oncall here, acking the page. I’m looking.

pagerduty-bot: P-89233 acknowledged by alex.

devon: seeing a short spike in router tail latency aligned with a burst of KV-cache misses. Proxy retries tick up, but no 5xx surge. Looks like warmup/cold-path activity.

maria: any customer impact reported?

devon: no external errors in Sentry, no dropped requests in the dashboard. Canary sees latency only; production p50/p90 steady. Likely transient.

lisa: could be autoscaler adding nodes/warmup or a transient network blip. I’ll kick a small scale-up for the dedicated pool to speed warm cache.

alex: running quick scale command now:
```
# add 1 node to dedicated-gpu-prod
rdwctl pool scale --name dedicated-gpu-prod --delta 1
```

alex: done — node request submitted, kube shows new node provisioning. Also temporarily rerouting 10% canary traffic to fallback-quantized variant per routing policy to reduce tail.

incident-bot: Note: routing policy applied -> fallback-quantized receives 10% of canary traffic.

devon: KV warmup traces show prefill jobs starting, cache hit rate climbing. 95th drops to ~520ms after ~90s.

alex: confirmed via logs: no client errors, latency trending down.

maria: great. still think we should suppress repeated canary pages if pattern is warmup-related — create follow-up? :thumbsup:

devon: creating follow-up ticket: INC-3175 - Investigate KV-prefill timing and canary threshold tuning. Assigning to eng-runtime.

alex: handing off monitoring to daytime oncall. I’m stepping off.

incident-bot: PagerDuty P-89233 auto-resolved (condition cleared).

lisa: adding a short postmortem note in the ticket: transient canary-tail spike during scale/warmup; no customer impact observed. Recommend lowering sensitivity for synthetic canaries or gating alerts behind sustained breach >120s.

maria: ack, thanks all. Closing thread after 10m stable. :white_check_mark:
